program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (crop-cells cells color)
      (let* ((norm (normalize-cells cells))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells norm)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (third bb)) (+ 1 (fourth bb))
          (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) color 0)))))
    (let* ((objs (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0)))
           (best (argmin (lambda (o) (+ (* 10000 (obj-size o))
                                        (* 100 (obj-r1 o))
                                        (obj-c1 o)))
                         objs)))
      (crop-cells (obj-cells best) 8))))
